trello.name: Fix staging deploy by rotating expired CI registry token
trello.desc: The staging deploy job has been failing (red) since the morning because it cannot pull the base image — the CI registry token expired after yesterday's token rotation. Steps: (1) Regenerate a new registry token. (2) Update the CI secret with the new token. (3) Re-run the staging deploy job and confirm it goes green. Acceptance criteria: staging deploy job succeeds, base image pulls successfully, and team members can test on staging again.

trello.name: Send updated Meridian proposal with new pricing to Lena by end of day
trello.desc: Meridian requested an updated proposal reflecting the new pricing, promised to them by end of day today. Steps: (1) Pull the final numbers from the spreadsheet. (2) Drop the final numbers into the proposal document. (3) Send the updated proposal to Meridian's procurement contact, Lena, via email (her email address is available in the kickoff thread). Acceptance criteria: updated proposal document contains the final pricing numbers from the spreadsheet and has been emailed to Lena by end of day.
